datasheet_identity.title: BZT52C2V0S THRU BZT52C75S SURFACE MOUNT ZENER DIODES

extraction_notes: This is a family datasheet; the BZT52C24S row was selected from the BZT52C2V0S through BZT52C75S electrical-characteristics table.
The BZT52C24S row gives VZ = 22.8 V minimum, 24.0 V nominal, and 25.6 V maximum at IZT = 5 mA; maximum ZZT is 70 ohm at IZT, maximum ZZK is 250 ohm at IZK = 1 mA, and admissible IZM is 5 mA.
The Fig. 2 BZT52C24S trace points are digitized readings from the plotted curve; source-axis current in mA was converted to A and no intermediate points were interpolated.

No capacitance or reverse-recovery specification is published for this part. The remaining page 3 plots are series-wide typical characteristics without a uniquely identified BZT52C24S trace and were not assigned component-specific points.
